concerns.text: FR-004 mandates verifying resource constraints using 'taskset' for CPU core pinning. No task exists to implement the 'taskset' logic or the verification logic to assert the 4-core constraint. T014 only mentions 'time -v'.

SC-002 requires measuring 'training stability' via gradient norm distribution. Tasks T008/T019 implement homeostasis but lack a specific task to implement the logging or metric collection logic required to measure and record gradient norms for this success criterion.

FR-006 requires validation on a 'statistically independent distribution'. T011 verifies data generation, and T016 records degradation, but no task explicitly verifies the statistical independence of the test set distribution (e.g., via a distribution distance test or schema check) as required by the spec.

FR-003 requires a systematic ablation study across 'at least three distinct model variants'. T026 implements the ablation logic, but there is no explicit task to orchestrate the training of the three specific variants (full, ablated recurrence, ablated inhibition) and aggregate their results for the cost curve.

Edge Cases specify handling for 'non-differentiable functions' (failed approximation flag) and 'CPU memory limit exceeded' (dynamic batch size reduction). No tasks (e.g., in T060-T064 or T027) address implementing these specific fallback mechanisms or error codes.

Plan claims Principle V (Versioning Discipline) is 'PASS' via a script that 'will run'. T044 is an unimplemented task in the 'Polish' phase. There is no task ensuring this script is integrated into the CI/build pipeline to enforce the 'GATE' status during development.

T031A and T031B are split into 'Producer' and 'Consumer' tasks for the same statistical comparison logic. This creates a redundant task structure where T031B (Consumer) depends on T031A (Producer) for the same file/module, which is an implementation artifact rather than a distinct requirement coverage. Consider merging or clarifying the split.
